headline: Reserve Bank Raises Interest Rates in Split 6-3 Decision
summary: The Reserve Bank raised interest rates in a split 6-3 decision, prompting calls for the treasurer to rein in spending amid mounting cost pressures.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence borrowing costs, consumer spending, and valuation models across financial markets.

impacts.name: Australia Official Cash Rate
impacts.why: A rate hike directly increases the official policy interest rate.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Monetary policy tightening alters benchmark interest rates and borrowing costs throughout the economy.
